news.title: New Health Sciences Academic Building provides state-of-the-art space to 3 UI programs
news.summary_en: The Health Sciences Academic Building now houses three top-ranked programs — Communications Sciences and Disorders; Health, Sport, and Human Physiology; and Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Sciences — all under one roof.

news.title: Ultra-tiny diamond sensors could offer a more precise look inside living cells
news.summary_en: A research team co-led by the University of Iowa has developed a new approach for sensors made out of nanodiamonds to more accurately measure the temperature in cells. The findings could improve tools for studying disease, such as cancer.
